fact: DCCMS says it completed installation of the PUMA 2025 satellite reception system at its Blantyre headquarters, replacing PUMA 2015 and giving access to Meteosat Third Generation products.

Malawi's Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services piloted the WFP-developed PRISM tool in five districts, which DCCMS officials say integrates satellite imagery with rainfall, soil moisture and vegetation indices to give real-time drought insight.
system: PRISM (Platform for Real-time Impact and Situation Monitoring)
